subject: Remove dead conditions around the multi/exec check (#2168)
reason: Pure dead-code removal with no behaviour change. The removed conditions (c->cmd->proc != multiCommand && c->cmd->proc != watchCommand) in the transaction-queueing check at server.c:4377 are unreachable on both builds: MULTI and WATCH carry the CMD_NO_MULTI flag (src/commands/multi.json, src/commands/watch.json), so when c->flag.multi is set they are rejected earlier in the same processCommand call at server.c:4145 ("Command not allowed inside a transaction") and never reach the queueing check; without flag.multi the branch is skipped entirely. No reply, transaction state, or replication behavi
